findings.evidence: gh api repos/BentenAI/benten-engine/branches/main/protection returns 10 required-status-check contexts: cross-leg byte-equality gate (T9), create-benten-app cold install, release-build (--no-default-features) gate, T9 cross-leg byte-equality gate, Phase 2a exit-gate aggregate, docs ↔ Rust enum ↔ TS types parity, self-test (meta-assertion that the detector actually detects), cargo-deny (licenses / bans / advisories / sources), cargo-audit (belt-and-suspenders), Cargo.lock integrity. observations.title: Stable+MSRV clippy gates require explicit feature flags to PASS (otherwise compile-error on integration tests consuming feature-gated `pub mod testing`)
observations.note: The R2 verification shows that running `cargo +stable clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` (or +1.95 equivalent) WITHOUT the explicit `--features benten-eval/testing,benten-engine/test-helpers,benten-graph/testing` flag returns 11+ E0432/E0433/E0560/E0599 compile-errors against integration tests that import benten_eval::testing / sample_for_test / sample_for_label / etc. CI ci.yml line 141 correctly passes the feature flags. §3.5j codifies '+stable clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings' WITHOUT mentioning the required feature flags — this is a §3.5j wording gap that could lead reviewers to a false-RED diagnosis. NOT a code finding; suggested as a §3.5j amendment to mirror CI's feature-flag invocation.
observations.disposition: OBSERVATION — orchestrator-direct text amendment to §3.5j in dispatch-conventions.md to reflect CI's `--features benten-eval/testing,benten-engine/test-helpers,benten-graph/testing` invocation. NOT a R2-blocking finding.
